class.name: ViewSystem
class.brief_description: Demo C++ system exercising cached [code]View[/code] and change-aware [code]ChangeView[/code] iteration.
class.description: An example system compiled into the extension. It builds a cached [code]World::view<Position>[/code] and a change-aware [code]ChangeView<Position>[/code] in [code]_setup[/code], then counts the entities seen by each on every tick. Demonstrates compile-once views and change-aware iteration.

method.name: get_changed_count
method.description: Returns how many entities the change-aware view reported on the last tick.

method.name: get_view_count
method.description: Returns how many entities the cached view saw on the last tick.
